description: This file defines interfaces and data structures related to Orleans grain reminders, including reminder state data class and grain interface definitions for testing reminders with different grain types.

classes.name: ReminderState
classes.description: A record class representing the state of a reminder, including reminder details, registration times, fired times, and logs.

methods.name: StartReminder
methods.description: Starts a reminder with specified name, optional period, and validation flag.

methods.name: StopReminder
methods.description: Stops a reminder by name or by reminder object.

methods.name: GetReminderPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the period of a specified reminder.

methods.name: GetReminderDueTimeAndPeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the due time and period for a specified reminder.

methods.name: GetCounter
methods.description: Gets a counter value by name.

methods.name: GetReminderObject
methods.description: Retrieves the reminder object by name.

methods.name: GetRemindersList
methods.description: Gets a list of all reminders.

methods.name: GetReminderStates
methods.description: Retrieves the current states of all reminders.
